d:
Vietnam has some incredible places to explore, but this time, Anushia and I decided to experience something different. We travelled on the Chapa Express, one of Vietnam's famous luxury sleeper trains, before exploring the beautiful rice terraces and mountains of Sapa in northern Vietnam.
Our journey started in Hanoi, where we boarded the Chapa Express for an overnight train journey towards Lao Cai, the gateway to Sapa. Unlike ordinary trains, Chapa Express offers comfortable sleeper cabins, beautifully designed interiors, soft beds and a more private travelling experience.
